Button.Tooltip: Switch the selected seed on (every other seed off) and, with Per-Seed Saves, put its own save slots into the game. Close the game first. Double-clicking a seed does the same.

Label.Text: ▶ = switched on ★ = its saves are in the game

The generator reads what it needs from your own game (.nup or romfs), changes the item placements and writes only the changed files into <output>/<mod name>/romfs. Install that folder as a layered mod (emulator: .../mods/contents/<title id>/<mod name>/romfs, console: atmosphere/contents). Nothing from the game is bundled with this program — share settings strings, not mod folders.
